mapper.insert: insert into dispatch_assignment_evidence(evidence_id,tenant_id,dispatch_request_id,assignment_id,task_id,agent_id,attempt_no,event_type,outbox_status,worker_id,claim_token_hash,claim_until,dispatch_token_hash,fencing_token_hash,runtime_session_id,ack_evidence_id,gateway_status,recovery_classification,evidence_json,occurred_at,created_at) values(#{evidence.evidenceId},#{evidence.tenantId},#{evidence.dispatchRequestId},#{evidence.assignmentId},#{evidence.taskId},#{evidence.agentId},#{evidence.attemptNo},#{evidence.eventType},#{evidence.outboxStatus},#{evidence.workerId},#{evidence.claimTokenHash},#{evidence.claimUntil},#{evidence.dispatchTokenHash},#{evidence.fencingTokenHash},#{evidence.runtimeSessionId},#{evidence.ackEvidenceId},#{evidence.gatewayStatus},#{evidence.recoveryClassification},cast(#{evidence.evidenceJson} as jsonb),#{evidence.occurredAt},coalesce(#{evidence.createdAt},now())) on conflict do nothing
mapper.select: select * from dispatch_assignment_evidence where dispatch_request_id=#{dispatchRequestId} order by occurred_at desc limit #{limit}
select * from dispatch_assignment_evidence where dispatch_request_id=#{dispatchRequestId} and attempt_no=#{attemptNo} and event_type=#{eventType} limit 1
select count(*) from dispatch_assignment_evidence where dispatch_request_id=#{dispatchRequestId} and attempt_no=#{attemptNo} and event_type=#{eventType}
